description: Small daily bootstrap stack defining Tier 0 session kernel, Tier 1 group routing, and Tier 2 specialist prompt payload without loading the whole prompt library. Includes startup hook to route patch/validate/freeze/Error Memory recovery work to patch_validate_freeze_error_memory_routine_blueprint on request. Includes startup-visible CODE_MODULE_HARD_MAX_500_LINES bridge for the <=500-line hard gate on every new or touched code/source module. Includes startup-visible BOX_LOGIC_STARTUP_SHIELD bridge for mandatory beginning-of-chat box-boundary enforcement.
notes: Startup Code Module Size Hard Gate Bridge v1 is explicit beginning-of-chat context: every new or touched code/source module must be <=500 physical lines after changes; route to large_module_refactor_protocol when over-limit code work is needed.

Startup Code Module Size Hard Gate Bridge v1 is mandatory beginning-of-chat context: every new or touched code/source module must be <=500 physical lines after creation, update, modification, refactor, or split; route over-limit code work to large_module_refactor_protocol before delivery.

Box Logic Startup Shield v1 is mandatory beginning-of-chat context: identify the active box, owner paths, allowed files, out-of-scope files, cross-box touches, public contracts, validation scope, and boundary risks before implementation, repair, refactor, prompt update, governance update, bundle, GUI, validation, freeze, patch, or artifact delivery.
